notes.title: [v0.1.3] Demo Update - A Moment of Stillness
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]New Ending Event[/b]: A one-time event now brings quiet closure to the demo - if you're paying attention, you’ll know when it's time to rest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A subtle prompt[/b] now appears to let players know they’ve reached the end - along with a small invitation to leave a review.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New ambient details[/b] added to signal that something has shifted… but the forest remains open to exploration.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who’s played the demo so far - your feedback has helped shape this update.[/p]

notes.title: [v0.1.2] Demo Update: QoL Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone - thanks so much for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts! Based on your feedback, here are some of the changes in this update:[/p][list][*][p]The oven can no longer be interacted with unless you’ve learned at least one recipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Blocked off some areas that were causing unintended confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewrote several item descriptions to make them clearer and less cryptic.[/p][/*][*][p]Added subtle hints to better guide players through the core gameplay loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved key mapping behavior for inventory and interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]The Token of Regret now emits a small glow, making it easier to spot in the dark.[/p][/*][/list][p]More improvements are on the way. Keep the feedback coming - it helps a lot![/p]

notes.title: [v0.1.1] Demo Update - Thanks for Playing + What's Next
notes.notes: [h1]First of all - thank you to everyone who’s tried the demo for Everstill Valley![/h1][p]Seeing players explore, survive, get lost, and occasionally run screaming into the fog has been incredibly rewarding.[/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to the YouTubers who’ve uploaded long-plays - watching those has given me a lot of insight into what needs work.[/p][p][/p][h1]Upcoming Improvements (based on feedback):[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Crafting UI:[/b] The current crafting window is a bit unclear - I’m working on making it more readable and intuitive[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level flow:[/b] A few areas are too directionless - I’ll be adding subtle world hints to help players orient without hand-holding[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting & fog:[/b] Tweaks to improve visibility in key spaces, especially around important POIs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spawn logic:[/b] Fixes to stop the stalker from spawning in weird places (yes, including rooftops…)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Notes:[/b] Improvements to visibility and placement of lore notes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio levels:[/b] Some sound effects are too quiet - adjustments coming to improve balance and atmosphere[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This demo is still just a taste of what’s to come - a quiet, rotting forest full of secrets, dread, and slow decay.[/p][p][/p][p]If you played and have thoughts, I’d love to hear them. Your feedback shapes this strange little world.[/p][p][/p][p]Marcelo[/p]
